name: Pixi Overnight Retinol Oil 30ml Youth-Preserving Night Treatment with Peptides and Ceramides
description:
Wake up to smoother, firmer, and more radiant skin with Pixi Overnight Retinol Oil. This youth-preserving night treatment uses time-release retinol to gently refine skin texture while reducing fine lines. Enriched with peptides to support elasticity and ceramides to strengthen the skin barrier, it provides lasting hydration and repair overnight. Suitable for all skin types, the lightweight oil absorbs quickly, leaving skin renewed, nourished, and glowing by morning. Paraben-free and cruelty-free.
Key Features:
Volume: 30ml / 1.01 fl oz
Time-release retinol helps renew and smooth skin
Peptides firm skin and support elasticity
Ceramides strengthen barrier and lock in moisture
Reduces appearance of fine lines and restores radiance
Paraben-free and cruelty-free
How to Use:
Use in the evening after cleansing and toning
Warm a few drops in your hands and press onto skin
Follow with moisturizer if needed
Apply SPF during the day when using retinol products
Ingredients:
Retinol smooths & refines
Peptides firm & revitalize
Ceramides provide time-release moisture
Safety Information:
For external use only
Avoid contact with eyes; rinse immediately if contact occurs
Discontinue use if irritation or redness develops
Keep out of reach of children
Consult a doctor if pregnant or nursing before use
Always use sunscreen daily as retinol increases sun sensitivity

Package Includes:
1 × Pixi Overnight Retinol Oil 30ml
